name: @warplan/infra-bootstrap
description: One-time Terraform that creates the S3 bucket for subsequent .tfplan files.

scripts.test:local: bash -n ../../scripts/tf-deploy.sh && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: bash -n ../../scripts/tf-deploy.sh && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate
